title: Concamerate
summary: CONCAMERATE, verb transitive [Latin To arch; an arch, arched roof, or chamber.] To arch over; to vault; to lay a concave over; as a concamerated bone.

inlines.v: CONCAMERATE, verb transitive [Latin To arch; an arch, arched roof, or chamber.] To arch over; to vault; to lay a concave over; as a concamerated bone.
